dict.string: Lexi AI needs access to your microphone to record audio for speech-to-text transcription.
Lexi AI needs system audio recording permission only to transcribe meeting and call audio when you start a meeting.
Lexi AI needs system audio recording permission only. On some macOS versions the system shows this under Screen Recording; use system audio only—Lexi does not record your screen.
Lexi AI needs Apple Events permission to paste transcribed text at your cursor position.
Lexi AI needs accessibility permissions to identify the text field at your cursor position and provide context-aware transcription.
